mechanism: In the widget builder's SET_FIELDS action handler (useWidgetBuilderState.tsx), the logic that determines the new sort field after a group-by field is removed from a chart widget derives its candidate sort field from firstYAxisNotEquation and firstActionPayloadNotEquation. Both of these are undefined when their source arrays contain no non-equation fields (e.g. yAxis contains only FieldValueKind.EQUATION entries, or the remaining action.payload fields are empty or equation-only). The code then passes this undefined value into generateFieldAsString(undefined as QueryFieldValue); the `as QueryFieldValue` type cast suppresses the TypeScript error but does not prevent undefined from reaching the function at runtime, so generateFieldAsString accesses `.kind` on undefined and throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind').
